question: Does one board plus a generated per-release contract carry everything three boards carried, judged on this skill's own journey?

artifacts.summary: POC seed. Absorb four card types the independently drawn board had and ours lacked: a story-level status and gap, an open-question card, a one-journey sentence, and a release label carrying its own coverage count. Demote the journey board from a canvas to a per-release contract generated from the journey file, checked by three lints that must each be shown firing on a real defect. Migrate this repository's own journey to the new format; a format that cannot describe the tool that made it describes nothing. No cross-repository evidence and no browser work in this task.
